files.README.md:
# Hollisvale Print Works

Press job log, one line per job: date, time, job ID, press, status, and the account name
on reprints. Statuses are REPRINT, RETRY, ERROR and OK; they are distinct outcomes.
files.docs/shift-roster.md:
# September press shifts

Early 06:00-14:00, late 14:00-22:00. Night work is outsourced and does not appear here.

Fine, keep your count then. How many of those reprints were for the Walkerton account? The bare number, please.
And which press ran the most reprints that month?
